page: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The CPU cache configuration includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 480 MB of L3 cache. It features 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The server includes 118 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, though it does not bundle any public IPv4 addresses or GPU hardware.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance asymmetry between single-core and multi-core operations. The single-core CPU performance measured via stress-ng is average, scoring 2268.08, and single-threaded gzip compression is strong at 30.79 GB/sec. However, multi-core CPU performance is poor, scoring 2300.17 in stress-ng, which places it in the bottom 10% of tested servers. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with read-only large block bandwidth at 25.26 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at a poor 11.86 GB/sec. Passmark metrics reflect these limitations, with a CPU score of 4093.02 and a memory score of 1767.79, both falling into the bottom 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D2ds_v7 offers a dedicated hardware profile with local storage, making it a viable option for entry-level workloads that require consistent CPU allocation without burstable credits. However, the low multi-core scaling and weak memory write performance represent significant tradeoffs. Database operations and web serving throughput are modest, with Redis SET operations at 4.06 million operations per second and static web serving at 4.86 GB/sec. Consequently, this instance is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, single-threaded processing tasks, basic web serving, and development environments rather than memory-intensive or highly parallelized applications.
